extDescription.message: Shows whether a page has a chat window (chatbot) and whether the interface says a machine is replying. Sends and stores nothing.

chatScriptOnly.message: The page code contains a chat script, but no window was rendered.

vendorUnknown.message: Vendor not identified, probably a custom or unknown solution.

vendorHybrid.message: This tool supports both human agents and bots; without opening the window this cannot be decided.

notOpened.message: We did not open the window.

unsupportedText.message: The extension has no access to it, for example browser pages or the Chrome Web Store.

signalOnly.message: A signal, not a legal assessment.

art50.message: Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 places an obligation on providers of AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons. A live chat with a human is not covered by it.
